answer_text: The KB does not publish numeric default values for BGP Hold Time or Keep-alive on a Cato site; it describes Hold Time as the period the site waits before declaring a neighbor down and shows that Hold Time and Keep-alive are configured in the Advanced BGP Settings. If two neighbors have different Hold Times, the lower Hold Time is used for both neighbors, and the Keep-alive interval is recalculated accordingly (for example, Hold Time 30 yields a Keep-alive of 10).
